metaTitle: Driver's License Help and Everyday Services in Taiwan | CROSSING PROXY
metaDescription: CROSSING PROXY helps foreign residents in Taiwan ask about a driver's license test, exchanging a foreign license, documents, Chinese–Vietnamese translation, motorbike sales, shipping, and daily life. Eligibility follows the motor vehicle authority, and results are not guaranteed. No prices are published here.
position: CROSSING PROXY is a one-stop everyday-services partner for foreign residents in Taiwan.
heroLead: Document help, driver's license assistance, translation, motorbike sales, cross-border shipping, and everyday services, so each step in Taiwan is simpler.
heroPoints: Who we are: CROSSING PROXY, an everyday-services partner for foreign residents in Taiwan.
What you can ask about: documents, a driver's license, Chinese–Vietnamese translation, motorbike sales, SIM cards, shipping, and daily questions. Rentals and company plans are in preparation.
Choose a language once. The menu also shows that nationality's services, plus services that apply to every nationality.
Where to start: choose a language, open a service, read the status and limits, then ask on LINE.
How to reach us: LINE official account @681ydjcz. This site does not send the message for you.

faq.q: Can I read the site in English and still look at services for Vietnam?
faq.a: Vietnam-specific services are on the Tiếng Việt page, together with services for every nationality. Choose Tiếng Việt in the language menu and both the language and the service filter change. English shows the shared services.

faq.q: Do you file visas, residence permits, or work permits?
faq.a: We do not act as an immigration, visa, or residence-permit agent, and we do not promise any government result. Document help means explaining, organizing, and translating. Work that needs a legal qualification is not labeled as a partner referral until a real lawful partner is confirmed.
Prices are not published. There is no starting price on this site. Ask on LINE. We explain how the fee is calculated before we begin.

faq.q: What cannot be shipped to Vietnam?
faq.a: Meat and meat products are not accepted; batteries and power banks are restricted; liquids and medicine are usually restricted too. Rules change, so confirm again before you ship.

faq.q: Can I rent a scooter or furniture?
faq.a: Not yet. Short- and medium-term scooter rental, and household or furniture rental, are planned. An inquiry only records interest. It is not a booking.
No. We do not collect or send money. If social posts compared legal transfer options, that was general information, not a paid service on this site.

faq.q: Does this website store the form?
faq.a: No. The page is static. After you copy the text, it stays on your device until you paste it into LINE. Do not enter an ID, passport, ARC number, or other sensitive data.

faq.q: Can foreign residents ask about a scooter license test or exchanging a foreign license for a Taiwan license?
faq.a: Yes, as an inquiry. That can cover booking a test, registering a retake, the exchange steps, organizing papers, written-test notes and traffic rules, and motor vehicle office procedures. Translation and accompaniment are separate questions and are confirmed case by case. Eligibility and documents follow Taiwan's motor vehicle authority. We do not guarantee a pass or a successful exchange.

pendingStrip: Address, licenses, the team, partners, and client stories stay off this site until the operator confirms them.
legal: These notes follow the direction of current Taiwan rules. They are not legal advice. Immigration, visas, residence permits, private employment services, transport and shipping permits, and scooter-rental contracts and insurance are not offered as something we can do directly, or as a partner referral, until the owner confirms the qualification or a real lawful partner.
We do not guarantee a visa, a job, residence, or any government approval. Whether a document is accepted is decided by the authority.
A first question does not ask for an ID card, passport, ARC, or other sensitive data. Do not put that data in a public URL or in this static form.

Whether shipping and home pickup already have the required permits is pending. Until that is confirmed, the description is help with questions and the existing shipping flow. It is not a claim that we hold a particular transport license.
Help with buying or selling a scooter does not replace registration, insurance, or traffic rules. Short- and medium-term rental is not open, so there is no rental contract to sign.

Driver's license assistance is an inquiry, help organizing papers, and translation or accompaniment only when confirmed case by case. It does not guarantee a passing result or a successful exchange. Eligibility and documents follow Taiwan's motor vehicle authority.

If a GoatCounter site code is set, this site loads that tool to count page visits, referring links and utm campaign parameters, and clicks that open a service description, open the inquiry form, or open the official LINE account. It also aggregates browser, operating system, country, language, and screen width. The operator can turn each of those off in the GoatCounter dashboard. GoatCounter does not set a browser cookie and does not build a personal profile. An IP address stays only briefly in server memory to count a visit and is not written to the database. Statistics are stored in the European Union (Germany and Finland). Form text, names, phone numbers, and document data are not sent. Nothing is loaded when there is no site code.
